sloka: आकर्णात्स विकृष्याथ चापमिन्द्रारिराहवे ।मुमोच तं शरं क्रुद्धस्त्रिपुरे शङ्करो यथा ।। ७.२१.४२ ॥
transliteration: ākarṇātsa vikṛṣyātha cāpamindrārirāhave ।mumoca taṁ śaraṁ kruddhastripure śaṅkaro yathā ।। 7.21.42 ॥

translations.english: Then, Indrajit, the enemy of Indra, enraged in battle, drew his bow up to his ear and released that arrow, just as Shiva did at Tripura.
